name: Wage or benefit payments immediately withdrawn by another person
description: Salary, welfare or loan proceeds are withdrawn in full by someone not the account holder or sent to a third party on receipt.
fp: Remittance to family is common after payday.

sources.text: FATF and APG, Financial Flows from Human Trafficking (2018)

UNODC, Global Report on Trafficking in Persons (biennial; specify edition e.g. 2024)
